Magnificent Beach Home In Signature Estate

A considered expression of contemporary coastal living, this five-bedroom residence pairs clean architectural lines with natural textures, warm timber and subtle African influences. Light-filled interiors unfold onto generous entertaining spaces, a landscaped garden and an inviting pool—all framed by sweeping coastal views.

The main suite is a private retreat, complete with a spa-inspired bathroom and walk-in wardrobe, while a separate guest suite offers exceptional privacy. Set within exclusive Signature Estate, residents enjoy private beach access, biometric security and 24-hour patrols.

Perched high above the Atlantic on Nestleton Road, Clifton, this landmark residence occupies what is widely regarded as South Africa’s most exclusive address.

Set against the slopes of Lion’s Head, the home commands uninterrupted views across Clifton’s beaches and the Atlantic Seaboard beyond. Designed as an entertainer’s retreat, the architecture unfolds across expansive, double-volume living spaces that open seamlessly onto ocean-facing terraces, an infinity pool and jacuzzi suspended above the coastline.

Interiors are bold yet refined private cinema, cocktail bar, temperature-controlled wine cellar, spa facilities, gym and bespoke office suite all integrated into a residence that balances scale with intimacy. Each bedroom functions as a private retreat, with panoramic sea views and spa-style en suite bathrooms.

This is not simply a home, but a statement of position, privacy and permanence on the Atlantic Seaboard.

An architectural masterpiece set within the prestigious Pinnacle Point Golf Estate, this residence is the definition of modern coastal luxury.

With clean lines and expansive open spaces, the home captures natural light through floor-to-ceiling windows, framing uninterrupted views of the ocean and championship golf course. Every detail reflects elegance — from the sleek kitchen with state-of-the-art appliances to the seamless indoor-outdoor flow that leads to a rim-flow pool, jacuzzi, and landscaped gardens.

Four spacious en-suite bedrooms create private sanctuaries, while a private cinema room, indoor braai, and full smart-home automation ensure comfort and convenience. Sustainability is built in with solar panels, an inverter system, and central air-conditioning — making this not just a home, but a statement of design, innovation, and effortless living.

Experience unmatched luxury at this five-story home atop Bantry Bay with stunning Atlantic Ocean views. This architectural masterpiece blends opulence and practicality, offering five en suite bedrooms with private balconies and breathtaking northern views. The master suite is a haven of indulgence with a spacious walk-in dressing area and a full bathroom. Enter into a grand hall featuring a penthouse office, chic guest bathroom, and easy access to all levels via a private lift. 

The third level is designed for top-notch entertainment with open-concept living, dining, and kitchen areas leading to a rim-flow pool overlooking the ocean. The fourth level is an entertainer’s paradise with a state-of-the-art movie theatre, bar, pool table, and a tranquil jacuzzi haven. Additional luxurious features include a modern home cinema, open chef’s kitchen, walk-in fridges, and closets. The ground floor hosts a private wellness space with a fully equipped gym, restrooms, and laundry facilities.

The mansion’s elegant architectural lines, opulent interior furnishings, warm timber cladding, and floor-to-ceiling glass doors enhance the spacious living areas. Situated in one of Cape Town’s most sought-after neighborhoods, residents enjoy unparalleled security, world-class dining, pristine beaches, and vibrant nightlife. This remarkable mansion sets a new standard for luxurious living on the Atlantic Coast.

 For Sale: R138,000,000 | $7,575,000
